detaileddescription.para: For each requested and unmasked APU core, obtains the core's saved resume address, requests wakeup, then clears and disables the serviced IRQ bit.

parameterdescription.para: Wakeup request status bits for APU cores.
Wakeup interrupt mask bits; a clear bit is unmasked.

simplesect.para: Status from the last successful wakeup request, XST_INVALID_PARAM if a requested core is absent, an error from XPmCore_RequestWakeup, or XST_FAILURE if no unmasked request is handled.

briefdescription.para: Service APU and RPU power-up request interrupts.

detaileddescription.para: Reads both power-up status and interrupt-mask registers and dispatches each nonzero status value. Logs an error if the final dispatch attempted fails or if neither status register requests a dispatch.

briefdescription.para: Service APU and RPU power-down request interrupts.

detaileddescription.para: Reads both power-down and power-up status and mask register sets and dispatches each nonzero power-down status. Logs an error if the final dispatch attempted fails or if neither power-down status requests a dispatch.

briefdescription.para: Service APU and RPU wakeup request interrupts.

detaileddescription.para: Reads both wakeup status and mask registers and dispatches each nonzero status value. Logs an error if the final dispatch attempted fails or if neither status register requests a dispatch.

Reads the power-down IRQ status and mask registers and dispatches them to the APU/RPU power-control handler, which powers down matching cores and acknowledges serviced bits. A dispatch failure is logged. Status remains XST_FAILURE when no bit matches, so an idle interrupt also logs an error.

briefdescription.para: Top level power interrupt handler that dispatches power up, power down, wakeup and power control requests to their handlers and ACKs the serviced interrupts.

parameterdescription.para: Interrupt number that triggered the handler

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, XST_FAILURE or error code during failure
